Manage explicit skill packages and per-profile sharing

Usage: larp cc skills [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add      Copy one explicit package into the immutable managed store
  remove   Remove a package after disabling all profile references
  enable   
  disable  
  list     
  matrix   
  sync     Apply sharing changes or explicitly resume an interrupted transaction

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
